summary.text: Joe Pavlov is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 64 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Joe Pavlov's general-election opponent is Ken Heuvelman (D).
He worked as a teacher for 38 years at Marysville High School before taking office in 2025.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Pavlov graduated from Marysville High School, earned an associate degree from St. Clair County Community College and a bachelor's degree in communication education from Michigan State University, and holds a graduate degree in teaching from Oakland University.
His career experience includes working as a teacher for 38 years at Marysville High School.
Pavlov assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2025, and in 2025-2026 is assigned to the Agriculture, Education, Elections and Ethics, and Families, Children, and Seniors committees.
